title: Tinkering Teacup Octopus
statement: A teacup-sized octopus with translucent lavender arms and freckles like amber ink spends its afternoons arranging smooth porcelain fragments into elaborate, slightly crooked constellations. Beneath a single honey-colored light, its tank is a quiet landscape of midnight sand and ceramic arches; whenever a passing shadow interrupts its work, it turns one curious eye upward, then makes room in the pattern.
